discussion:
If SSHD is enabled then it _MUST_ be configured for a hybrid Post Quantum Cryptographic (PQC) key exchange.

NOTE: On macOS 15.2 and higher the SSH configuration can be reset to the macOS default by running /usr/libexec/reset-ssh-configuration.

steps.shell:
include_dir=$(/usr/bin/awk '/^Include/ {print $2}' /etc/ssh/sshd_config | /usr/bin/tr -d '*')

if [[ -z $include_dir ]]; then
  /usr/bin/sed -i.bk "1s/.*/Include \/etc\/ssh\/sshd_config.d\/\*/" /etc/ssh/sshd_config
  include_dir=$(/usr/bin/awk '/^Include/ {print $2}' /etc/ssh/sshd_config | /usr/bin/tr -d '*')
fi

sshd_config_kex="$(/usr/sbin/sshd -G | /usr/bin/awk '/kexalgorithms/{print $2}')"
if [[ "$sshd_config_kex" != *"mlkem768x25519-sha256"* ]]; then
  if /usr/bin/grep -qi '^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]' "${include_dir}01-mscp-sshd.conf"; then
    /usr/bin/sed -i '' '/^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]/I s/$/,mlkem768x25519-sha256/' "${include_dir}01-mscp-sshd.conf"
  else
    echo "kexalgorithms $sshd_config_kex,mlkem768x25519-sha256" >> "${include_dir}01-mscp-sshd.conf"
  fi
fi

for file in $(ls ${include_dir}); do
  if [[ "$file" == "100-macos.conf" ]]; then
      continue
  fi
  if [[ "$file" == "01-mscp-sshd.conf" ]]; then
      break
  fi
  /bin/mv ${include_dir}${file} ${include_dir}20-${file}
done
